title: Analysis-Investors return to US stocks as AI, earnings growth feed fear of missing out
title_zh: 分析-人工智能、盈利增长加剧投资者对错失良机的担忧，投资者重返美股
summary: U.S. stocks are rebounding and investors, reassured by diplomacy around the Iran war, are coming off the sidelines as AI-related spending and a strong start to the earnings season fuel a new fear: missing out on stocks' latest rally.
summary_zh: 美国股市正在反弹，投资者因围绕伊朗战争的外交而放心，但由于人工智能相关支出和财报季的强劲开局引发了新的担忧：错过了股市最近的反弹，他们开始离场观望。

title: CEO turnover is near record highs, and more experienced execs are making for the exits
title_zh: 首席执行官更替率接近历史新高，更有经验的高管正在寻求退出
summary: CEO turnover is near highs, and the average tenure of departing leaders is also on the rise.
summary_zh: 首席执行官的更替率接近高位，离职领导人的平均任期也在上升。

title: Satellite startup Univity raises $32 million in push to become Europe's largest operator
title_zh: 卫星初创公司 Univity 融资 3200 万美元，力争成为欧洲最大运营商
summary: By Gianluca Lo Nostro April 23 (Reuters) - Univity, a satellite internet startup backed by the French state, said on Thursday it had closed a 27 million euro ($32 million) funding round, as it plans
summary_zh: 作者：Gianluca Lo Nostro 4 月 23 日（路透社）——由法国政府支持的卫星互联网初创公司 Univity 周四表示，已按计划完成了 2700 万欧元（3200 万美元）的融资

title: Dassault Systemes reports first-quarter revenue in line with estimates
title_zh: 达索系统报告第一季度收入符合预期
summary: French software maker Dassault Systemes on Thursday reported first-quarter revenue of 1.51 ‌billion euros ($1.77 billion), in line with estimates, helped ‌by strong demand for its 3DExperience and Cloud businesses.
summary_zh: 法国软件制造商达索系统周四公布，第一季度收入为 15.1 亿欧元（17.7 亿美元），与预期相符，这得益于对其 3DExperience 和云业务的强劲需求。

title: SK Hynix’s Profit Surge Falls Short as ‘Supercycle’ Debate Rages
title_zh: 随着“超级周期”争论的激烈，SK海力士的利润激增未能实现
summary: (Bloomberg) -- SK Hynix Inc. reported a five-fold jump in quarterly profit that yet failed to impress investors questioning how long booming sales for AI memory chips can last.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——SK 海力士公司公布的季度利润增长了五倍，但未能给投资者留下深刻印象，他们质疑人工智能存储芯片的蓬勃销售能持续多久。

title: Microsoft bets big on AI in Australia with $18 billion investment
title_zh: 微软在澳大利亚投资180亿美元大力发展人工智能
summary: By Fabiola Arámburo April 23 (Reuters) - Microsoft said on Thursday that it will invest A$25 billion ($17.9 billion) in Australia by the end of 2029 to boost computing and artificial intelligence
summary_zh: 路透 4 月 23 日 - 微软周四表示，到 2029 年底将在澳大利亚投资 250 亿澳元（合 179 亿美元），以推动计算和人工智能发展

title: Tencent, Alibaba in Talks to Join DeepSeek’s First Funding Round

title_zh: 亚洲股市追随华尔街创历史新高，但油价上涨构成风险
summary: (Corrects to add dropped letters in first paragraph) By Stella Qiu SYDNEY, April 23 (Reuters) - Asian shares tracked Wall Street higher on Thursday, led by record highs in Japan, South Korea and
summary_zh: （更正第一段中删除的字母）作者：Stella Qiu 悉尼，4 月 23 日（路透社） - 亚洲股市周四跟随华尔街走高，日本、韩国和日本股市创下历史新高。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures slide as oil tops $100, Tesla slips after earnings
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克期货因油价突破 100 美元而下跌，特斯拉在财报公布后下跌
summary: The US-Iran battle for control of the Strait of Hormuz spurred oil gains, while Tesla's capex warning weighed on its stock.
summary_zh: 美国与伊朗争夺霍尔木兹海峡控制权的战争刺激了石油价格上涨，而特斯拉的资本支出警告则打压了其股价。
